judgment.observations: The centered chandelier has closely matched framing, overall scale, and radial bulb placement. The reconstruction simplifies the ornate central hub, collars, and curved arm details into thinner, straighter elements. No major chandelier component is obviously missing, although small overlapping details are less distinct. Ceiling framing differs substantially: the reconstruction adds a prominent upper crossbeam within view and places the lower beams nearer the bottom edge. The reference has clearer horizontal ceiling-board seams, stronger shadows, and darker brown structural beams. The reconstruction’s beams are pale beige, its gold is brighter and more sharply reflective, and visible render noise reduces material fidelity. Arms appear connected to the central hub in both images.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The reconstructed chandelier may have flatter arm depth and a simpler central suspension assembly, but these are uncertain impressions from silhouettes and shading. The ceiling could differ in pitch or camera perspective; a single view cannot distinguish those causes or establish hidden geometry and support correctness.
